reviews.title: Nice skinny pants
reviews.review_text: I usually avoid ordering jeans online because the sizing with Levi's varies from jean to jean. So I went to the store to try the 511s, as they don't carry 510s there. So, I ended up ordering size 29 x 32, as the 511s did fit comfortable with that size. Anyway, I've been wearing these 510s since I ordered them, and I didn't want to take them off after my first wear. They are skinny on thighs down to the calves, but they have enough room at the leg opening to look like a go-to pair for work and going out. The only issue I have is that these pants have an extra crotch space between the thighs, and as these pants run a little small on waist and thighs, the crotch area is about an inch loose. These jeans do stretch well though, and they fit better after every wear.

reviews.title: All 510 Skinny Fit jeans aren't created equal
reviews.review_text: I bought 2 pair if 510 skinny fit jeans in the same size/length for my son which he has had a pair of before. I ordered the Lake Anza & rigid dragon finishes. The Lake Anza pair had stretch material in them and they fit my son perfectly. Then he tried on the rigid dragon pair but couldn't even get them passed his knees. So I had to return them at my own expense which I don't think is fair. I don't think i'll be buying anymore from this site, because it seems you must try every color in the same fit/size to know if they will fit.

reviews.title: Different than they used to be
reviews.review_text: I've been wearing 510s for years and have always LOVED the way they fit. Recently I bought two pairs of the Rigid Dragon, what happened? The crotch sits too low and the waist sits too high, also the denim isn't nearly as comfortable as it used to be. I wish Levi's would go back to the old 510s.

reviews.title: Third Revision of Khaki 510's, The only pair of 510's that I had to return
reviews.review_text: I've had 3 pairs of the 510 khakis, all three have been different. This current revision different then the other 510, I'm normally a 31-32, I got them in with another pair of black 510s that fit perfectly like they usually do. The rise was WAY higher then normal and the waste was closer to a 29/30 and the inseam is much shorter then it should be. Ordering a 32-34 to see if it fits right...

reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] The fit is ok just the bottom part of jeans gave me a bit more room than I thought I would have so it kinda looked like bell bottoms and NO NOT LIKE STACKED JEANS REAL BELL BOTTOMS

reviews.title: Not strectchy
reviews.review_text: I bought some 510s in store that were actually stretchy so that I could bike in them and be active in them. These are just a normal pair of tight jeans that I cannot move freely in. Why does it say stretchy if they are not?

reviews.title: Mom jeans
reviews.review_text: What happened to the old Levis 510 ? (98% cotton 2% spandex. i had several pairs and got many compliments on them. The jeans sold here are 92% cotton 7% elastic and 2% spandex. They are baggy in the crotch and a thinner (mom jean) stretch material. i have donated my recent purchase to charity. i have resorted to looking on E-Bay for the 98% cotton formula. Levis........ PLEASE bring them back , they were the perfect jean.

reviews.title: Not like the original 510, circa 2008-10
reviews.review_text: The Levi's 510 happen to be my most favorite and irreplaceable fitting, cut, and style of jean. When they first got released, I bought most cuts and colors: black denim, blue denim/ gold inner, plum, etc. With the recent releases, I've noticed that not only has manufactured jeans become inconsistent in listed sizes across all retailers, but the fitting has also changed drastically. Although the thigh has stayed tight, the leg not longer fits skinny, and the ankle taper is horrible and awkward. I've clinged on to my now diminishing pairs of original 610s. The ones you had to break in because they were so tight! For those complaining about the 510 now, these Jeans are branded super skinny, not skinny, slim, and straight fit. Well now, they might as well be.

reviews.title: Not Skinny
reviews.review_text: As a lot of other reviews have said, Levi's drastically changed the fit of the 510 jeans. I have 2 pairs that are about 2 years old and those fit exactly how I need them to (wearing 28x30 jeans and finding a pair that fit me well is not an easy task). When I ordered a new pair (Jet Black) in April after having finally worn through my old ones, I was really disappointed to see how loose the pants were. They're a "slim" fit at best, and will no longer be my go-to for new jeans.

reviews.title: VERY comfortable
reviews.review_text: These may be skinny jeans, but, probably because of the mix of materials, they are not tight, but rather very comfortable (however, if you are looking for truly skinny jeans, these may not be for you). I only wish there were more 510's in different shades of blue that had the same mix of materials in them.

reviews.title: It's okay, waists come big though.
reviews.review_text: I bought Super Skinny 510™ Jeans - Rigid Grey and those were awesome. But this one came out so much bigger. It doesn't really look like the picture. And I HAVE to wear belts even though i wear 32's.(I bought waste 32) I should've bought waist 31 or 30 I wouldve been fine, I'm pretty much putting this in my closet or giving it to my friend because it's not giving me a pretty fit. if the size is right, it's awesome. but wrong size? ur not gonna have the "pretty" fit that you're looking for.

reviews.title: Small waist and little stretch
reviews.review_text: The tightness of the 510 jeans varies slightly from color to color and these definitely run on the tighter side. The color is beautiful, definitely darker and more "rigid" looking than the rigid stretch model. These would fade nicely if you wore them for a while without washing. However, the waist on these runs very small. I wear a waist size 31 in the rigid stretch model, but both the 31 and 32 waists were too small for me in this style. I am unsure if the waist will stretch out some, because then the 32 would fit me fine. I don't think I am willing to risk that though. The more pressing issue is the lack of stretch. That tag reads 1% elastane, but it is very hard to move around in these. I could not lift my leg up very far at all. They seem significantly less stretchy than the rigid stretch model these seem to be replacing. Overall I love the color, but I do not like the lack of mobility.

reviews.title: Theres a trick to these jeans...
reviews.review_text: So ive always bought the original 510 skinnys back in the late 2000s and i guess u guys changed the fit... at first these new jeans fit good and with wear they become very loose, not skinny at all, but after its 2-3 wash and drys in the dryer they shrink and become tight and stay tight. So dont get discouraged! They're definitely not like the original 510s but theyre not that bad after the few washes. Then they look and fit like true skinnys.

reviews.title: Dude...
reviews.review_text: So the Jet fit a bit below where the Rigid Stretch does in terms of how they wear, however they aren't uncomfortable. (It's possible when you've been wearing the Rigid Stretch for years that you'll just so happen to notice the slight difference). Regardless they are phenominal. The Color is black indeed, not the typical 'Well it was described as black'. And they're Levi's, what more cuold you ask for? Wash in Cold Water and Hang Dry, they'll feel brand new every time.

reviews.title: Exactly as expected
reviews.review_text: I was worried about buying these jeans because of the change Levi's made in the fit. I went ahead and bought them anyways despite the reviews. I have three pairs of 510's, and to my surprise, this pair fit in the legs and waist exactly the same as the others. HOWEVER the rise in these jeans are WAY off from the other pairs of 510's I own. The rise is 1 - 1 1/2 inches lower (as pictured) and looks COMPLETELY off when worn with a tucked-in shirt. That being said, these jeans are still Levi's quality, and I wear them every day.

reviews.title: Fits very small and no stretch
reviews.review_text: I bought a pair of 32x32 jeans but they fit a couple sizes small. I have the same model 32x32 510™ Skinny Fit Advanced Stretch Jeans and they fit perfectly. There is even some room around waist. Both pairs are also made from 99% cotton and 1% elastane, but these do not have any stretch. I cannot even put these on because they are very tight on calves and around waist. I do not understand how it can be so much different. Completely disappointed and I cannot return back as I bought them online while away.

reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.review_text: These jeans are O.K, it depends on what your looking for. The rise of the waist is pretty high compared to most skinny jeans that you'd find at the various skate stores at the mall. This is really the only downfall of these pants, if you dont wear them all the way up on the waist, and try to sag them even a little, they no longer are skinny jeans and turn into straight fit even a slightly baggy fit at the thighs (Though maybe ordering a size smaller might fix this problem, try before you buy!). So it really depends how you wear your jeans. The material is more along the lines of trousers/regular pants as opposed to jeans, again this is good or bad depending on what you want.

reviews.title: One Smooth U Posture Boost
reviews.review_text: This would be a nicer bra if it had a different type of fastener rather than the hooks/eyes that are difficult to work with, especially if someone has any type of hand or wrist problems. Also, why is it that so many front hook bras are made with the posture feature? Manufacturers seem to think anyone who needs a front hook bra has posture issues, when in reality it's often shoulder, wrist and/or hand issues.

I like front closure bras, but this bra is hard to work with and hook closed or open. I runs small in width .I usually wear a 38C, got a 40C in this Bali bra. The cup size was perfect. The straps are not adjustable, but these straps fit me very well. Got the only color available. Pretty good support. 179
The only times the underwires weren't digging in was when I was standing. The back was nice and smooth but I won't buy again.
too small order bigger like 2 to 3 sizes bigger feels comfy looks cheap due to no adjustments availability very difficulty to close front closer hook n eyes.

reviews.title: Just an ok bra

reviews.title: Getting the right size is key, and not easy
reviews.review_text: I hesitated on getting this because I saw reviews that said it ran small and I needed the largest size. I gave it a shot because it was on sale. If you get the right size, it is actually pretty comfortable. Unfortunately, getting the right size is a trial and error deal. I normally wear 44D and that one was so big it was neither supportive or attractive--it really gapped at the sides. Also, I ordered the special offer of 3 bras and then was mysteriously informed that only black was available and they canceled the beige. It worked out, since the black didn't fit and I would have been stuck with 3 bad bras, but if they had fit I would have been unhappy that I was able to order something that I was told a week later wasn't really available. I tried again, going down to a 42D and that was better (and available in beige). Still a little bit prone to sticking out on the sides--the cups aren't quite cut to fit right at the very outside and the underwire doesn't pull them in enough. Maybe if you're not overweight, getting all of those hooks together in the front is easier, but I find it a little challenging, and sometimes they pop open (not all, but the top one or two will pop depending on what I'm doing). Overall it's more comfortable than a sports bra (that just squishes everything, this is an real bra), and the straps don't dig like a traditional bra. I can't honestly say if it's doing anything for my posture, but I think it is a bit smoother all around than my traditional bras.

reviews.title: One little issue...

I'm going to try sewing over the little hole it came out of, and see if it stays put. I was considering buying another one, as I liked it so much, but I will hold off until I see how well the repair works.

The ones you had to break in because they were so tight! For those complaining about the 510 now, these Jeans are branded super skinny, not skinny, slim, and straight fit. Well now, they might as well be.

reviews.title: Not Skinny
reviews.review_text: As a lot of other reviews have said, Levi's drastically changed the fit of the 510 jeans. I have 2 pairs that are about 2 years old and those fit exactly how I need them to (wearing 28x30 jeans and finding a pair that fit me well is not an easy task). When I ordered a new pair (Jet Black) in April after having finally worn through my old ones, I was really disappointed to see how loose the pants were. They're a "slim" fit at best, and will no longer be my go-to for new jeans.

reviews.title: Pros and Cons
reviews.review_text: I ordered two pair of these 510s, Nightshine & The Rich, and when I first tried them on they felt a little too tight and stiff for my liking (I usually wear 511s). I was a little skeptical about keeping them but I decided to give them a try. I kept the Nightshine pair on for about 7 hours hoping they would wear in at least a tad and stretch out a bit, and surprisingly so, they did. Although they are not yet my most comfortable pair of jeans, I feel like once they are nice and broken in, they will be one of my favorites. My only complaint is, as other customers have reviewed, the crotch is wayyy too low. I really have not had a pair of Levi's (510s,511s,514s)that have had the crotch this low, or felt this low at least.

reviews.title: Small waist and little stretch
reviews.review_text: The tightness of the 510 jeans varies slightly from color to color and these definitely run on the tighter side. The color is beautiful, definitely darker and more "rigid" looking than the rigid stretch model. These would fade nicely if you wore them for a while without washing. However, the waist on these runs very small. I wear a waist size 31 in the rigid stretch model, but both the 31 and 32 waists were too small for me in this style. I am unsure if the waist will stretch out some, because then the 32 would fit me fine. I don't think I am willing to risk that though. The more pressing issue is the lack of stretch. That tag reads 1% elastane, but it is very hard to move around in these. I could not lift my leg up very far at all. They seem significantly less stretchy than the rigid stretch model these seem to be replacing. Overall I love the color, but I do not like the lack of mobility.

reviews.title: Theres a trick to these jeans...
reviews.review_text: So ive always bought the original 510 skinnys back in the late 2000s and i guess u guys changed the fit... at first these new jeans fit good and with wear they become very loose, not skinny at all, but after its 2-3 wash and drys in the dryer they shrink and become tight and stay tight. So dont get discouraged! They're definitely not like the original 510s but theyre not that bad after the few washes. Then they look and fit like true skinnys.

reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.review_text: These jeans are O.K, it depends on what your looking for. The rise of the waist is pretty high compared to most skinny jeans that you'd find at the various skate stores at the mall. This is really the only downfall of these pants, if you dont wear them all the way up on the waist, and try to sag them even a little, they no longer are skinny jeans and turn into straight fit even a slightly baggy fit at the thighs (Though maybe ordering a size smaller might fix this problem, try before you buy!). So it really depends how you wear your jeans. The material is more along the lines of trousers/regular pants as opposed to jeans, again this is good or bad depending on what you want.

reviews.title: Fits very small and no stretch
reviews.review_text: I bought a pair of 32x32 jeans but they fit a couple sizes small. I have the same model 32x32 510™ Skinny Fit Advanced Stretch Jeans and they fit perfectly. I cannot even put these on because they are very tight on calves and around waist. I do not understand how it can be so much different. Completely disappointed and I cannot return back as I bought them online while away.

reviews.title: Jeans fit differently than other 510's

Black skinny jeans are obviously very cool, but this product could be improved!

reviews.title: Aligning the phone to charge is a pain
reviews.review_text: After travelling 2 months with it, heres my honest feedback: Works well with the watch and pods. But not with the charging pad for the iPhone 13... To be clear. The wireless charging pad works. But aligning my phone can be tricky and misleading. It was not what I imagine where u can just drop the phone on the surface and expect it to charge. You have to position the phone on top of the pad until u hear a ding and see the lighting symbol showing on ur phone. Sound easy right? I thought so when I watch the YouTube reviews. It sometimes takes a few tries to get the alignment right. And when there's the ding sound and lighting sign on the phone screen, I had to wait for sign to go off and check and make sure the phone is charging. The reason to check is because the sounds and signs only tells you it detect the alignment, but it does not confirms it is charging. The last time I did the above, let my 10% batt phone charge overnight, woke up found my phone still 10%. It could be accidentally bump the table/charger and cause to misalign the phone and charge pad. Or anything else. But after that, I just went back using my lightning cable. Conclusion. For people who got the money, loves the wireless concept and don't mind the above issue, go for it. For people on a budget and/or focus more on practicalities and efficiencies, just stick with the cable for the phones and original chargers for the pods and watches.
